Famous for their Indian masala pizza.
A quirky hipster bar with old arcade games and on some nights, live bands of varying talent.

A great little wine bar with emphasis on Italian varieties.

An Italian restaurant that's larger than it looks from the outside, extending back into the middle of the block. Delivery.

Good, not fanciful Chinese food, and quiet enough that you can talk to your dinner companions.
Heavy gay bar with a rowdy crowd and lots of bears, but for some this is the definitive Castro bar.
Very popular gay bar with great food, a nice balcony, and a much calmer crowd than the 440 Castro.

Great bartenders, cheap strong drinks, music videos, and pinball.
